entry-lifecycle: add, edit, find by tag, remove, and rebuild an index.

The editor is the test binary in its helper mode: it appends the text of E2E_EDITOR_APPEND to
the file kb hands it, so kb edit needs no host editor.

  $ kb init --model fake:8
  created location $WORK/proj/.kb
  created store "default" in $WORK/proj (model fake:8)

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/deploy.md
  added data/deploy.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb add --dir $WORK/notes/runbook
  added data/runbook/README.md (3 chunks)

  $ kb list --tag ops
  PATH                    SUMMARY                                            UPDATED     VERIFIED
  data/deploy.md          Steps to deploy and the checks to run afterwards.  2026-02-01  -
  data/runbook/README.md  What to do when the pager goes off.                2026-02-02  -

  2 entries

  $ env 'E2E_EDITOR_APPEND=Rollback takes about ten minutes.'

  $ kb edit data/deploy.md
  reindexed data/deploy.md (2 chunks, 1 embedded)
  entries: 1 scanned, 1 reindexed, 0 skipped; chunks: 2; embed calls: 1

The edit is reindexed, so search finds the new sentence at once.

  $ kb search "rollback takes ten minutes" --mode fts --caller claude
  search 1 · 1 hit
  [1] data/deploy.md › (intro) · updated 2026-02-01
  Deploying the service › (intro)
  # Deploying the service

  Tag the release, run the pipeline, and watch the dashboards for ten minutes.
  Rollback takes about ten minutes.
  search_id=1

  $ grep Rollback data/deploy.md
  Rollback takes about ten minutes.

  $ kb show data/deploy.md
  ---
  title: Deploying the service
  summary: Steps to deploy and the checks to run afterwards.
  tags: [ops, release]
  updated: 2026-02-01
  ---
  # Deploying the service

  Tag the release, run the pipeline, and watch the dashboards for ten minutes.
  Rollback takes about ten minutes.

Removing a single file is immediate. A directory entry holds several files, so it needs --yes.

  $ kb rm data/deploy.md
  removed data/deploy.md

  $ ! exists data/deploy.md

  $ kb rm data/runbook
  [stderr] kb rm: data/runbook/ is a directory entry; pass --yes to remove data/runbook/ and everything in it
  [exit 1]

  $ exists data/runbook/README.md

  $ kb rm data/runbook --yes
  removed data/runbook/ and 2 files

  $ ! exists data/runbook

  $ kb list
  no entries

Rebuild from the files on disk and write the optional index.md snapshot.

  $ kb add $WORK/notes/deploy.md
  added data/deploy.md (2 chunks)

  $ kb reindex --all
  entries: 1 scanned, 0 reindexed, 1 skipped; chunks: 0; embed calls: 0

  $ kb index
  index.md regenerated (1 entries)

  $ grep deploy.md index.md
  | [data/deploy.md](data/deploy.md) | Steps to deploy and the checks to run afterwards. |

-- notes/deploy.md --
---
title: Deploying the service
summary: Steps to deploy and the checks to run afterwards.
tags: [ops, release]
updated: 2026-02-01
---
# Deploying the service

Tag the release, run the pipeline, and watch the dashboards for ten minutes.

---
# On-call runbook

Acknowledge the page, check the dashboards, and follow the linked procedure.

# Restart procedure

Restart the database first, then the workers.
